bullets.text: Apple Pay Under Fire - A £1.5 billion lawsuit claims **Apple**'s control over Apple Pay harms UK consumers.
App Store Ads Expansion - **Apple** will introduce multiple ads in search results starting March 3 in the UK.
Gmail's Spam Issues - Users report misclassification of emails and increased spam in **Gmail** inboxes.
AI Headlines in Google Discover - **Google** keeps AI-generated headlines in Discover due to user satisfaction.
Gemini's Personal Intelligence - **Google**'s Gemini can now access user data across services for enhanced AI interactions.
Anker's 3-in-1 Charger - **Anker**'s Prime 25W MagSafe charger offers a sleek solution for Apple devices.
PopWheels' E-Bike Batteries - A startup is replacing gas generators in food carts with e-bike batteries.
AI's Future at Davos - Tech CEOs discuss AI's potential and challenges at the **World Economic Forum**.
